snippet.title: Saving the world while having a dream! |  Awaking Beauty Chosen as a BitSummit Official Selection
snippet.description:
"Awaking Beauty" has been chosen as a BitSummit Official Selection! Find us at booth 3F-D40.

It is a roguelite side-scrolling action game.

Players will take on the role of a hot-blooded girl, donning sleeping-walking mechas to dive into the Dreamworld—a realm formed by human dreams—and battle monsters born from nightmares.

This video showcases actual gameplay footage, combat pacing, weapon switching, skill combos, and the action-packed experience enhanced by meta-progression.

⭐ SUPPORT US | Add to Steam Wishlist
If you are interested in this game, please add "Awaking Beauty" to your Steam Wishlist and follow our updates. Every wishlist addition is a crucial support that keeps our development going.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253950/Awaking_Beauty/

🔹 KEY FEATURES

- Arcade-style action gameplay
- Roguelite random progression and build-crafting
- American hand-drawn comic style × Surreal dreamworld
- Mecha fusion and transformation between different characters

This game is perfect for players who love Action Games, Roguelite, Co-op/Dual-Character gameplay, and Indie Games.

🎮 Steam Demo Available Now
Players can now personally experience the core combat system and the controls of dual characters.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253950/Awaking_Beauty/
